title: Wollecru – Sheep Farm, Wool Blankets & Lamb in Westport, NY
description: A 60-acre farm in the Champlain Valley raising sheep for naturally dyed wool blankets, sheepskins, and lamb shares, plus a plant nursery and vineyard.
name: wollecru
tagline: A farm that utilizes sheep in an ecologically diverse system to produce high quality wool, wine, and flora.
